firstPlayerRule: There is no set first player. In each investigator phase, the investigators each take one turn in the order of their choice.
clarifications: Each round has an investigator phase followed by a mythos phase run by the app.
On their turn, an investigator performs up to two actions; after all investigators have taken a turn, one of them presses the app's end phase button.
